summary:
I built W3a, the admin "API" section and its settings pages, against the real routes in backend/src/modules/connectors/routes.ts and posRoutes.ts and the WhatsApp handlers in auth/routes.ts. `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` in frontend/admin is clean (exit 0). No earlier partial edits existed apart from the Payroll register link, which the HR fix agent had already added to moduleCatalog, so I left it as it was.

**The /connectors hub** has exactly two cards:
- **WhatsApp:** whether it is configured, where the setting comes from, and the delivery check's state.
- **POS:** fiscal mode (Live / Off / Not required), a TEST badge, a health dot, card machine on/off, how many charges need attention, and the backlog counts.

**The WhatsApp page** was moved with `git mv` to /connectors/whatsapp and keeps the same endpoints. Additions:
- the note "Platform-wide: one gateway for every company";
- the delivery check, with "Check now";
- the live /health checks for WhatsApp (customerSignup, staffCodeLogin, passwordRecovery), read from the public /health;
- the inbound Meta note;
- colours switched to admin tokens.

next.config.js has a permanent redirect from /configuration/whatsapp to /connectors/whatsapp.

**The /connectors/pos page** belongs to the ACTIVE company and has six tabs:
- **Status:** the mode badge (Off / Live since … / TEST), last good answer, last test, last error, and backlog counters that open Submissions filtered to that status. It also lists card charges in needs_attention, unknown or unverified, with Resolve and Reverse for managers. It polls every 10 s and listens to the socket event `fiscal.filed`.
- **Fiscal setup:**
  - The §17.7 switch, "Fiscal reporting: Required / Not required (non-commercial or test company)". Only the CEO can change it, a reason is required, and it calls PUT /connectors/fiscal/reporting-required.
  - Driver and base URL fields, locked while the connector is live, with the server's 409 SWITCH_OFF_FIRST shown.
  - API key shown only as a hint, with Replace.
  - Webhook secret shown as a hint; Regenerate shows `newWebhookSecret` once, with Copy.
  - Webhook URL with Copy and "New address" (rotate).
  - Sync timeout, file at the till, file zero-value, max age, and a scenario picker for the test driver.
  - Test connection and Dry-run sale.
  - Go live and Switch off: CEO only, typed GO LIVE / SWITCH OFF, with a readiness checklist and the NOT_READY `missing` list.
  - Release all held: CEO only, all brands or one brand, no date range, no skip.
- **POS IDs:** the only editor of brand FBR / SRB ids (PUT /connectors/fiscal/brand-pos-ids), plus outlet overrides in settings.outlets.
- **Card machine:** driver, the "shown at the till" switch, base URL, key, secret, timeout, poll interval, the manual-reference fallback, machines per outlet, and Test card machine.
- **Submissions:** filters (status, kind, brand, dates, search), paging, and a drawer with the payload and the last 50 attempts. Actions are Retry, Record manual filing and Retry all failed. There is no Skip anywhere, and test-driver filings carry a TEST badge.
- **Card charges:** the reconciliation list; with the test driver, Approve and Decline.

When reporting is not required, a banner reads "Fiscal reporting: not required for <company> (non-commercial / test)". A held or switched-off connector and a live TEST driver each get a banner too. SECRET_KEY_MISSING (503) shows "Secrets cannot be saved yet — ask IT to set SERVD_SECRET_KEY on the server."

**Other pages:**
- **moduleCatalog:** added `api_whatsapp`, `api_pos` and `voided_prebills` (the exact §17.5 entry). Integrations loses the WhatsApp sub-link and its hint is now "Meta, email, webhooks, supplier portal". The FBR/SRB wording is gone from the `orders` gap note (the `integrations` note never had any), and I added an `api_pos` gap note.
- **appRoles:** the ModuleId union and the MODULES labels now include the three ids.
- **settings/integrations:** the tax-status fetch, the TaxAuthorityCards and the WhatsApp card are gone. In their place is one "WhatsApp and POS are in Dev → API" card and an Email / Webhooks card.
- **configuration/tax:** redirects to /connectors/pos.
- **configuration hub:** the WhatsApp and "Tax Rates & FBR" tiles are replaced by one "API connectors" tile, and FBR/SRB is gone from the Integrations and Brands copy.
- **Receipts:** the toggle now reads "Show fiscal invoice number and QR" (still the `showFbrInvoice` setting).
- **Marketing → Brands:** the tab is renamed "Tax registration". The FBR/SRB POS ID inputs are removed and no longer sent; a link to the POS connector replaces them. The province hint now says it is required for Sindh tax routing.
- **Help and onboarding:** the copy points to the POS connector instead of the old FBR worker or Configuration → Tax.
- **Onboarding tax rates:** onboarding no longer writes the legacy taxRate. It sets taxRateCash / taxRateCard from the province: Sindh 15 / 8, Punjab 16 / 5, and other provinces cash = card = their rate. When editing a brand, the rates are sent only if the province changed, so rates set in Brands are not overwritten.

I also added READMEs for app/connectors and components/connectors.
tests:
Typecheck: `cd /home/user/servd/frontend/admin && npx tsc --noEmit -p .` exits 0 with no errors, checked after the final edit. The admin app has no unit-test harness, so I added no tests. Following the hard rules, I did not run next build or next dev, did not hit any live backend and did not call production. Every call in lib/connectorsApi.ts was checked by hand against these route files:
- backend/src/modules/connectors/routes.ts: the PUT body (strict), the reporting-required body `{required, reason}`, release `{conceptId?}` strict, the document list item fields, and the GET /connectors shape including `fiscalReportingRequired` and `legacyDrained`.
- backend/src/modules/connectors/posRoutes.ts: the resolve / reverse bodies.
- backend/src/modules/auth/routes.ts: the WhatsApp and delivery-status routes.

I also checked the backend role sets so each control is shown only to the roles allowed to use it: CONNECTOR_ADMINS = admin + it, VIEWERS = those + management, CEO = admin, MANAGERS for resolve / reverse.
deviations:
1. finance/page.tsx: I left it unchanged. It is a server redirect to /accounting/pl-ledger, not a page with cards, and the Voided pre bills link arrives through the moduleCatalog entry once W2 adds the module id.

2. The go-live readiness checklist is computed in the browser. It is approximate: it checks every brand of the company, while the server checks only brands with orders in the last 30 days. The server stays the authority and its NOT_READY message is always shown; the `missing` list appears only once api.ts passes details through (needsOtherFiles 1).

3. Release has no date range and no Skip anywhere, per §17.0. The real route takes only `{ conceptId? }`, so the page offers "All brands" or one brand.

4. The §17.7 switch sits at the top of the Fiscal setup tab, and the not-required banner shows on every tab. When reporting is off, the fiscal connection, test, go-live and release cards are hidden; the card-machine tab still works.

5. Onboarding defaults: Sindh 15 / 8 (the existing table said 13 %, which the till never charges) and Punjab 16 / 5. KP, Balochistan, ICT, GB and AJK get cash = card = the province rate, because no reduced card rate is known for them. All of these stay editable per brand. The legacy `taxRate` is no longer sent; the backend's create default of 17 still fills that column, and nothing new reads it.

6. settings/integrations: next to the "WhatsApp and POS are in Dev → API" card I kept a small Email / Webhooks link card, so the email screen stays reachable from that page now the WhatsApp & email card is gone.

7. The Configuration hub's new "API connectors" tile uses a text glyph (⇄) instead of an emoji, because the tile type requires an icon. The new connector UI uses no emoji anywhere.

8. Card-charge Resolve / Reverse buttons on the Status tab are shown only to MANAGERS roles, matching the till routes. IT and finance see the list read-only.

9. The moved WhatsApp page now calls the same endpoints through connectorsApi, and its hard-coded emerald / red colours became s-* tokens.
